Photo 2 is a close-up of the bottom right corner of the palm rest, showing the Intel vPro sticker clearly, with 'i5' visible below the 'vPRO' text.

claims.claim: Direct uk used Dell 5431 core i5 12th generation
claims.evidence: The model '5431' is not visible in any photo. The Intel vPro sticker with 'i5' is visible in photo 2, but it does not confirm the 12th generation. The 'Dell' brand is visible in photo 1, but no model number is readable.
No backlighting is visible in the photos. The keyboard is shown in daylight, and no indicator of backlighting is present. The claim cannot be confirmed from the images.
The laptop appears clean and undamaged in all photos, with no visible dents, scratches, or stains on the chassis or keyboard.

risks.risk: The laptop may not be a Dell 5431 or may not have a 12th generation Intel Core i5 processor.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the bottom of the laptop showing the model number or a screenshot of the system information (e.g., BIOS or Windows About page) showing the exact model and CPU generation.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic Dell laptop with an Intel i5, not as a specific 5431 with 12th gen CPU.

risks.risk: The keyboard may not have backlighting as claimed.
risks.proof: A photo of the keyboard with the backlight turned on in a dark environment.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-backlit keyboard, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The screen may be cracked, dead pixels, or have other display issues not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A video or photo of the screen turned on, showing full brightness and color, with close-ups of corners and edges.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a laptop with an unverified screen condition, which may be discounted.

risks.risk: The laptop may have internal damage, battery issues, or not power on.
risks.proof: A video showing the laptop powering on, booting to the desktop, and running a simple task (e.g., opening a browser).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which is the worst-case scenario.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the bottom of the laptop showing the model number.
A video or photo of the laptop powered on, showing the desktop and keyboard backlight if available.
A photo of the screen turned on, showing full display quality.
A screenshot of the system information showing the exact CPU model and generation.
response.reason: The model number and CPU generation are not visible in the photos, and the keyboard backlight claim cannot be verified. The screen and internal functionality are also unverified.
